verdicts.title: Integral closure of rings of integer-valued polynomials on algebras
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Let $D$ be an integrally closed domain with quotient field $K$. Let $A$ be a torsion-free $D$-algebra that is finitely generated as a $D$-module.
